levels.surface: محمد بن عبد، الله بن نمير

notes: seven «ح»-joined branches; the names written after «كلهم عن» form the shared tail
«أبو خالد الأحمر، سليمان بن حيان» is one man written in apposition with no verb between (rule 7): the fuller name is kept
«بإسناد مالك» names Malik as the isnad phrase, not as a link here
«وفي حديث سفيان سمعت عمر بن الخطاب» gives Sufyan's wording a Companion; it cannot be placed after the shared tail, so it is not written as a route
«- يعني ابن غياث -» and «ومعنى حديثه» are glosses, left out
